about.title: About Career Compass
about.p1: Career Compass is built for Gujarat students standing at the most important crossroads of their life — what to do after 10th.
about.p2: We combine validated psychometrics, AI counseling, and real Gujarati/Indian career pathways to help every student — and every parent — choose with confidence.
about.missionText: To make world-class career counseling free and accessible to every Class 10 student in India, in their own language.
